title: There Was An Extra Face On Our Video Call #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine a late-night video call with your best friends.
Four of you. Four little squares.
Everyone's laughing at a dumb joke.
Then a fifth square appears. Camera off. No name.
Nobody else seems to notice it.
The fifth square's microphone turns on. You hear breathing.
You type in the chat: "Who added this?"
Your friend replies: "Added who? It's just the three of us."
Three? You count again. One of the squares is you, from behind.
*Your own square shows a hand reaching for your shoulder.
Would you turn around, or end the call? Comment A or B.
